Name: Additional Hairstyles (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[size=4][b]General[/b][/size]
This content pack utilizes Content Patcher to add 42 new hairstyles to Stardew Valley. There are styles for all hair lengths. You can select them in the character creation menu when you start a new farm or at the shrine of illusions in the wizard's basement once you've unlocked that. 

[b][size=4]Hat Compatibility [/size][/b]
Some of the more voluminous hairstyles can look a little weird with certain hats. I've chosen not to change those hairstyles while wearing a hat for now as they still work with most other hats, so this is not exactly a bug, but if you would like this change to be included for one or more of the hairstyles, please feel free to let me know in the posts tab. 

[b][size=4]Installing (PC)[/size][/b]
To install this content pack, download the mod file and extract the .zip file to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder. 

[b][size=4]Future Plans[/size][/b]
I'm looking into making a Fashion Sense version of this pack. I might also add more hairstyles if I feel like doing so in the future! 

If you'd like me to add a specific hairstyle, please attach a picture in the posts tab. No guarantees of course, but I'm always happy to take inspiration.

Enjoy! :)
